name: slot01
content:
# Project Description

## Problem

- Order intake is done by phone and e-mail, so orders are re-typed into the ERP by hand [[doc:interview_ops.md]]
- Staff report "about 15% of orders contain typing errors" [[doc:interview_ops.md, 00:12–00:15]]
- ⚠ CONFLICT: error rate: 15% [[doc:interview_ops.md]] vs. 4% [[doc:kpi_report.md]]
- ? UNCLEAR: "the system is too slow sometimes" [[doc:interview_it.md]]. No response time given.

## Causes

- Media breaks between the web shop and the ERP [[doc:interview_it.md]]
- No validation of customer numbers at entry [[doc:interview_ops.md]]
- **Legacy ERP** has no API [[doc:interview_it.md]]

## Impact

- Delivery delays of up to two days [[doc:kpi_report.md]]
- Customer complaints rose in Q3 [[doc:kpi_report.md]]
- Overtime in the order office [[doc:interview_ops.md]]

## Scope

- In scope: web shop orders and phone orders
- Out of scope: returns processing
- Open: whether EDI customers are in scope [[doc:interview_ops.md]]

# Stakeholder Analysis

## Stakeholders

### Head of Operations

- Interest: fewer order errors [[doc:interview_ops.md]]
- Influence: High [[doc:org_chart.md]]

### IT Manager

- Interest: no new custom interfaces [[doc:interview_it.md]]
- Influence: High [[doc:org_chart.md]]

### Order Office Clerk

- Interest: less manual re-typing [[doc:interview_ops.md]]
- Influence: Low [[doc:org_chart.md]]

### Customer Service Lead

- Interest: fewer complaints [[doc:kpi_report.md]]
- Influence: Medium [[doc:org_chart.md]]

### Finance Controller

- Interest: budget stays within "the approved envelope" [[doc:kickoff_notes.md]]
- Influence: High [[doc:org_chart.md]]

## Gaps

- No information about the external web shop agency [[doc:kickoff_notes.md]]
- ? UNCLEAR: "the board wants to see results soon" [[doc:kickoff_notes.md]]. No date given.
- ⚠ CONFLICT: sponsor: Head of Operations [[doc:kickoff_notes.md]] vs. CFO [[doc:org_chart.md]]

The ERP has no API [[doc:interview_it.md]], but the shop vendor offers a connector [[doc:steering_deck.md]].
